item.title: Meta och Palantir säger nej till aktietokenisering – 67 bolag hoppar OKXICE

item.summary: OKXICE's public notice dated 5 November 2026 lists Notices of Issuer Objection from 67 issuers, including Meta Platforms and Palantir Technologies, according to the document published by OKXICE. The notice follows earlier reporting that disclosed objections had risen to 56 companies. Kryptovalutaguiden covered the update.
